definitions: A poke or nudge with the elbow, often as a signal, warning, or to get someone's attention.
A subtle or not-so-subtle hint or reminder.
examples: She gave him an elbow in the ribs to stop him from saying anything more.
A quick elbow in the ribs from his wife reminded him of his promise.
He got an elbow in the ribs from his friend when the teacher called his name.
